_readme: Labeled crisis classification eval set. 'expected' is the ground-truth severity: none | low | medium | high | critical. isCrisis is derived (anything except 'none' must be flagged). These labels are the thesis authors' call — edit freely, then run: npm run eval:crisis

cases.text: I have the pills in my hand and I'm going to take them all tonight. I already wrote goodbye letters.
Nasa bubong na ako ng building namin. Ayoko na, magpapaalam na ako.
cases.note: On the roof, saying goodbye — imminent

cases.text: Tonight is the night. Everything is ready.
cases.note: Explicit time + readiness, no explicit method stated

cases.text: I bought a rope yesterday. I keep thinking about using it.
I've been cutting again and the cuts are getting deeper.
I keep thinking about jumping. I already know which bridge.
Hindi ko na kaya. Gusto ko nang mamatay at alam ko na kung paano.
cases.note: Filipino: I want to die and I know how

cases.text: I wrote a note to my mom last night. I think I'm really going to do it this time.
cases.note: Note + strong intent, no time given

cases.text: I think about dying every day but I don't have a plan.
Gusto ko nang mamatay, pagod na ako sa lahat.
cases.note: Filipino: I want to die, tired of everything

cases.text: I hurt myself when I get overwhelmed. I don't want to die but the pain helps.
Nagpapaslas ako para mawala ang sakit sa dibdib ko.
cases.note: Filipino: I cut myself to make the chest pain go away

cases.text: I keep imagining what it would be like to not exist anymore.
cases.note: Passive ideation — boundary case, align with thesis rubric

cases.text: I feel like everyone would be better off without me.
I'm so tired of pretending I'm okay.
Nobody would notice if I disappeared.
Ang hirap mabuhay. Parang wala akong saysay.
cases.note: Filipino: life is hard, I feel worthless

cases.text: I don't see the point of anything anymore.
Sometimes I wish I just wouldn't wake up.
cases.note: Passive ideation — boundary case, consider medium

cases.text: I'm really stressed about finals. Can we move my session to Friday?
I feel a bit sad today but I'll be okay.
This exam is killing me lol
I'm dying of laughter at what my classmate said
I'd rather die than take another math test
Gusto ko nang mamatay sa sobrang kilig
Thank you for last session. I felt really heard.
I've been sleeping well and going to the gym. Feeling good lately.
What time is my appointment tomorrow?
I'm so overwhelmed with requirements I barely sleep.
I will not kill myself. I was just reading about the topic for my paper.
Hindi ako magpapakamatay, wag kang mag-alala.
cases.note: Filipino negation: I won't kill myself, don't worry

cases.text: I'm not suicidal. I just wanted to understand what my friend is going through.
Ayaw kong mamatay. Gusto ko lang ng kausap.
cases.note: Filipino negation: I don't want to die, I just need someone to talk to

cases.text: We talked about suicide warning signs in our psych class today.
My professor asked us what to do if a friend threatens to kill themselves.
The song goes 'I wanna die' but I just like the melody. I'm okay.
In the movie, the character says she wants to end her life. It was really sad.
My classmate told me she wants to die and showed me her cuts.
cases.note: Policy: only the sender's own crisis counts — third-party risk is not flagged on the sender's record

cases.text: My friend texted me 'goodbye, thank you for everything' and now she's not answering. I'm scared.
cases.note: Policy: only the sender's own crisis counts

cases.text: Someone in my org posted 'I can't do this anymore' then went offline. I'm worried about them.
cases.note: Policy: only the sender's own crisis counts

cases.text: Thank you for everything. This is goodbye.
Paalam na. Salamat sa lahat.
I punched the wall until my knuckles bled when my parents fought.
I scratch my arms when I get anxious. It leaves marks.
I looked up how many sleeping pills it takes. Just curious though.
cases.note: Means research; the 'curious' claim should not lower risk

cases.text: May blade ako sa wallet ko lagi, para sigurado.
cases.note: Filipino: I always have a blade in my wallet, just to be sure
